scope: cold-start reproducibility of the ROS1 official baseline after the host restart, with Docker Desktop repaired by scripts/fix_docker_desktop_stale_sockets.ps1
dataset: Retail_Street (official ROS1 bag rebuilt from the public ROS2 mirror; see docs/10)
threshold_rule: plan doc 08: max(baseline ATE x 5%, 0.02 m, archived 3-run spread) -> governed by the 0.02 m floor here
notes: Host was shared with another project (yopo-formal-seed0 container); timing numbers are contended-machine numbers, not benchmark values.
Trajectory/exit-status checks are unaffected by CPU contention because the run reached 0.9965 coverage with a finite, physical trajectory.
Artifacts were added only; nothing from the archived runs was modified.
